scope: Fresh pinned offline GCC-native strict ASAN/UBSAN exact production-body pending model and complete packed-key/prefetch bounds/grow/full64 oracle model. Test State normal reset precondition matches production. No production helper suppression or runtime/harness/counter change.

commands.script:
set -eu
export ASAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1
export UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
g++ -std=c++20 -O1 -g -march=native -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -pthread -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer /repo/.build/round290/pending_model-gcc.cpp -o /out/pending_model
/out/pending_model >/out/pending_model.stdout 2>/out/pending_model.stderr
sha256sum /out/pending_model >/out/pending_model.sha256
g++ -std=c++20 -O1 -g -march=native -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -pthread -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer /repo/.build/round290/packed_prefetch_model-gcc.cpp -o /out/packed_prefetch_model
/out/packed_prefetch_model >/out/packed_prefetch_model.stdout 2>/out/packed_prefetch_model.stderr
sha256sum /out/packed_prefetch_model >/out/packed_prefetch_model.sha256

models.name: pending_model
